pages.title: Fortnite Drift's Kitsune Fox Mask with Pointed Ears and Its Distinctive Face Markings Coloring Page

pages.description: Fortnite Drift stands unmasked in his original sleeveless outfit on this printable coloring page, with swept-up hair and a folded face covering around his neck.
